sources.title: UK ETS Allocation Table for operators of installations
facts: The table lists installation free-allocation entitlements for the 2021 to 2026 allocation period.
Free allowances and Activity Level Change adjustments are compliance and entitlement evidence, not physical parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS Hospital and Small Emitter status
facts: Qualifying HSE installations have annual emissions targets and do not surrender allowances while they retain HSE status.
Eligibility thresholds and targets are scheme rules and must not be substituted for measured parcel emissions.

sources.title: UK ETS Guidance for ultra small emitters
facts: Ultra-small emitters for 2026 to 2030 are identified by the official qualifying list and must monitor emissions.
The USE threshold is 2,500 tonnes CO2e per scheme year; a threshold is not an observed parcel value.

sources.title: UK ETS Aviation Allocation Table
facts: The Aviation Allocation Table lists aircraft-operator free-allocation entitlement for the 2021 to 2025 allocation period.
Aviation allowance entitlement is not a land-parcel greenhouse-gas measurement.

sources.title: Functioning of the UK carbon market 2024
facts: The report summarises UK ETS scheme-year performance, participants, allowance supply, auctions and high-level compliance data.
Market operation and allowance data remain separate from physical site or parcel emissions measurements.

sources.title: Functioning of the UK carbon market collection
facts: The collection provides annual operational summaries of the UK ETS including participant, allowance, auction and compliance data.
Collection-level market statistics are not individual parcel emissions evidence.

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics 2026 planned methodology changes
facts: The note documents methodology changes applied to the final 1990 to 2024 UK greenhouse-gas emissions statistics.
Method-change estimates were provisional before the final release and methodology evidence is not a parcel measurement.

sources.title: Digest of UK Energy Statistics 2025 announcement
facts: The confirmed DUKES release is scheduled for 30 July 2026 at 09:30.
Because the release date is after this review date, unreleased 2026 publication values are not treated as observed.

sources.title: UK Energy in Brief 2025 announcement
facts: The confirmed UK Energy in Brief release is scheduled for 30 July 2026 at 09:30.
Future publication metadata may be recorded but future statistics are not treated as observed values.

sources.title: IED environmental permits issued 2026 M to R
facts: The Environment Agency collection lists 2026 permit decisions for sites with postcodes beginning M to R.
Permit issue, variation or surrender records establish regulatory status, not greenhouse-gas quantity.

sources.title: IED environmental permits issued 2026 S to Z
facts: The Environment Agency collection lists 2026 permit decisions for sites with postcodes beginning S to Z.
Permit records must remain separate from measured emissions and parcel binding.

sources.title: Voluntary monitoring reporting and verification period for EfW and waste incineration
facts: The voluntary MRV-only period for eligible energy-from-waste and waste-incineration installations began on 1 January 2026.
Participation and MRV policy scope do not by themselves prove a reported physical emissions value for a parcel.

sources.title: UK ETS policy overview
facts: The policy overview describes the UK ETS cap, free allocation, carbon-leakage policy and scheme development.
Policy design, auction reserve price and cap information are not direct parcel emissions observations.

sources.title: UK ETS and Carbon Price Support apply for compensation
facts: The guidance covers compensation for indirect UK ETS and Carbon Price Support costs.
Compensation eligibility and calculation inputs are financial-policy evidence, not physical greenhouse-gas measurements.

sources.title: Companies and products awarded ETS CPS compensation
facts: The publication lists companies and products awarded compensation for indirect UK ETS and CPS costs.
Receipt of compensation does not establish a measured emissions quantity for a facility or parcel.

sources.title: Products awarded ETS CPS compensation
facts: The page identifies products awarded UK ETS/CPS indirect-cost compensation.
Product eligibility is scheme-administration evidence and not an emissions observation.

sources.title: UK ETS baseline data collection 1 April to 30 June 2025
facts: Installation operators in scope submitted baseline data during the 1 April to 30 June 2025 collection window for allocation-period decisions.
Baseline data collection and eligibility evidence must not be treated as current parcel emissions without an explicit measurement and binding method.

sources.title: UK ETS cross-boundary CCS pipelines consultation accessible webpage
facts: The consultation considered options to streamline UK ETS regulatory requirements for cross-boundary CCS pipelines.
Consultation proposals are policy evidence and are not observed emissions reductions or parcel measurements.

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of sustainable aviation fuel consultation accessible webpage
facts: The consultation sought views on future treatment of SAF under the UK ETS and interaction with the SAF Mandate.
Consulted policy options and mandate obligations are not measured parcel emissions reductions.

sources.title: UK ETS domestic maritime main Authority response
facts: Domestic maritime enters UK ETS from July 2026 with specific first-year reporting and surrender arrangements.
Scheme scope and surrender deadlines are compliance rules and not parcel emissions observations.

sources.title: UK ETS international maritime voyages consultation accessible webpage
facts: The consultation proposes potential expansion of UK ETS to a share of emissions from international voyages.
Proposed future scope must not be treated as current measured emissions coverage.

sources.title: UK ETS scope expansion waste consultation
facts: The waste scope work sets out MRV-only implementation before future full surrender obligations.
Consultation and future scheme obligations are policy evidence rather than observed emissions values.
